summary:
When we joined the NASA Space Apps Challenge, our biggest thought was simple: when astronauts travel millions of miles from Earth and face a 20-minute communication delay, who helps them during a medical crisis? That question inspired us to build ASTRA-MED!

It is an offline-first health tracking and telemetry platform designed specifically for deep-space exploration. Because real-time cloud support is impossible in deep space, ASTRA-MED gives crews an autonomous, local AI Flight Surgeon. It monitors critical space health hazards like radiation exposure and spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome (SANS) right on board.

Featuring an interactive anatomical map and daily wellness tools, our platform ensures astronauts can diagnose symptoms and manage countermeasures instantly without internet. We created ASTRA-MED not just as a competition entry, but as a reliable digital companion to protect human lives on humanity's journey to Mars and beyond!"

Project Details: ASTRA-MED (Team ORBITRONIX)

What It Does & How It Works:

When we started building ASTRA-MED, our core idea was to create a smart, offline-first health tracking and telemetry platform for deep-space missions. Because real-time cloud support is impossible when astronauts are millions of miles away with a 20-minute communication delay, ASTRA-MED runs entirely on-board. It features an interactive anatomical diagnostic map, a biometric self-assessment logger, a POCUS/optical visual scan analyzer, a 5-variable NASA health hazard tracker, and a local AI Flight Surgeon simulation engine that guides crews through medical countermeasures instantly without internet.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

Long-duration spaceflight exposes human bodies to severe risks like radiation spikes and spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome (SANS). ASTRA-MED acts as a reliable digital companion on humanity’s journey to Mars and beyond. Its primary impact is transforming astronauts from passive patients into empowered commanders of their own health, ensuring crew safety, operational readiness, and peace of mind when Earth is too far away to help.

Tools, Languages & Technologies:

To build this robust system, we used a modern tech stack centered around Vite, React, and TypeScript (astra-project\astra), ensuring a smooth, futuristic Artemis HUD interface, high performance, and reliable offline capabilities.

Creativity & Team Considerations:

What makes ASTRA-MED creative is how it blends advanced medical telemetry with an intuitive, human-centered space design—making high-stress deep-space diagnostics feel natural and accessible. As a team, we carefully considered real spaceflight constraints like strict bandwidth limits, zero-gravity usability, complete offline isolation, and the psychological comfort of astronauts to ensure our solution is practical, empathetic, and mission-ready!
